Superiority Die is a subclass-specific resource for Battle Masters. It can also be obtained through the  Martial Adept feat.

Overview

Superiority Dice enable battle masters to use manoeuvre abilities such as  Riposte or  Evasive Footwork. Like all resources, they are displayed above a character's hotbar next to their other resources such as  Actions,  Bonus Actions, and Spell Slots.

Gaining Superiority Dice

The number of dice and their size depends on the level of the battle master. The feat  Martial Adept grants 1 die.

Recovering Superiority Dice

Superiority Dice recover fully on Short Rests and Long Rests.
